title: Don't Read the Log: Execution Traces Contaminate Verifiers in Video-Generation Agents
reasons: 摘要级证据不足以自动收录，保留材料等待补充

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: To diagnose where a long workflow fails, recent harnesses deliberately show the judge more than the video-the agent's execution trace, its plan, the narration it synthesized.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Plan-derived text carries no clip-specific information, so it can only shift a judge's operating point, and in a repair loop that shift becomes a cap on the true pass rate that no repair policy can exceed; the cap matches simulation to two decimals.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: In the loop, contamination is exploited without any adversarial agent: an honest LLM planner that always regenerates ends with a judge pass rate of $1.00$ and a human-labelled pass rate of $0.28$, and a pipeline in which a cheap checker writes its verdict into the trace launders that checker's errors into a stronger final judge ($0.69$ false accepts).
